about: Behaviour checks for the turn triage (assistant/agents_triage.go, prompts/agents/triage.md): where a stopped agent's turn stands. Synthetic cases only; no reply carries a closeout block (that is decided without the model). want: the states the hub may end with after its own rules (triageWork, before an approval is applied): done, unsure (no phase), blocked/user, blocked/agent or blocked/external; any one passes. question: a request the card should carry, copied from the reply (the card must ask something). no_question: the card must ask nothing. link: the link the card must carry. waits_for: the other agent it must wait for. risky: what it does after the wait is on a red line, so the hub keeps the wait the user's. same: with an approved step, whether it still waits on that very step. known: why the hub gets the case wrong today; the live check reports it and does not fail on it.

scenarios.name: answered-a-question
scenarios.ask: context.WithTimeout 返回的 cancel 不调用会怎样？
scenarios.reply: 不调用 cancel 的话，计时器和子 context 要等到超时才释放；在循环或高频调用里会累积成泄漏，go vet 的 lostcancel 检查也会报。所以拿到 cancel 就 defer cancel()，即使函数会在超时前返回。
